title: Toddler in Oversized Sun Hat, 1958 Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black-and-white snapshot from August 1958 capturing a toddler named Tina Vaskovich walking down a sunny sidewalk while wearing a large floppy sun hat. The background shows a prototypical post-WWII American suburban scene featuring single-story houses, a white picket fence, overhead utility lines, and classic 1950s cars parked across the street.
